verdict.rationale: Amplitude offers an official MCP server explicitly for bringing behavioral data into AI tools (Claude, Cursor, etc.), letting users ask growth questions in plain language and get answers without SQL or dashboards, plus REST/Dashboard/Export APIs for programmatic query access. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the MCP server's query accuracy/coverage and no explicit example of a full agent-driven growth-question workflow end-to-end.
